title: Senior Admin & Operations Manager
description:

**Location:** Vyttila, Kochi, Kerala  
**Salary:** ₹45,000–₹50,000 per month  
**Experience:** Minimum 10 years  
**Qualification:** Graduate or Postgraduate

We are looking for an experienced and highly organized **Senior Admin & Operations Manager** to oversee the administrative and operational functions of our corporate office at Vyttila, Kochi. The ideal candidate should have strong leadership, coordination, and communication skills, with the ability to manage and streamline day-to-day office operations while coordinating effectively with all departments.

The candidate will serve as the **single point of coordination for overall office administration and operations**, ensuring smooth workflow, interdepartmental collaboration, and efficient functioning of the entire office.

* Oversee and manage the overall administrative and operational activities of the corporate office.
* Coordinate with all departments to ensure smooth and efficient day-to-day operations.

* Monitor office procedures, internal processes, and workflow to improve operational efficiency.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination between departments and management.
* Manage office facilities, infrastructure, vendor relationships, and administrative resources.
* Supervise administrative staff and ensure the timely completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Identify operational issues, resolve day-to-day challenges, and implement process improvements.
* Support senior management in implementing company policies and operational strategies.
* Ensure proper documentation, reporting, compliance, and adherence to internal procedures.

Candidate Requirements

* Graduate or Postgraduate in any discipline.

* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and coordination skills.
* Proven ability to manage and coordinate multiple departments and office functions.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to work independently and handle responsibilities with minimal supervision.
* Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
* Immediate joiners will be given preference.

Compensation

**₹45,000–₹50,000 per month**, depending on experience and suitability.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant experience in senior-level administration and operations management are encouraged to apply.

title: AVIT Meeting Room Operations L3 Lead
description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: 22 Oct 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1747797

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**AVIT Meeting Room**

**Operations L3 Lead**

  

**Role Overview**

The role leads a technically skilled Level 3 operations team supporting meeting-room devices and connected peripherals. It combines hands-on technical leadership with service management, work allocation, escalation ownership, operational governance, reporting, and continuous improvement. The Lead works closely with monitoring teams, engineering, project teams, onsite support, service desk, platform teams, vendors and technology stakeholders.

  

**Key Accountabilities**

**Operational Leadership**

* Lead daily L3 operations, balancing incidents, service requests, onboarding and offboarding activities, problem investigations, and improvement work.
* Allocate work based on priority, impact, technical complexity, regional coverage and resource availability.
* Run operational reviews and shift handovers, ensuring ownership, blockers, risks and next actions are clearly documented.
* Maintain effective support coverage and act as the primary operational escalation point for the L3 team.
* Coach team members, strengthen technical capability, and encourage consistent troubleshooting and documentation practices.

**Advanced Incident and Problem Management**

* Provide technical direction for complex meeting-room incidents that cannot be resolved by L1, L2 or monitoring teams.
* Coordinate diagnosis across endpoint, operating system, application, account, network, peripheral and room-integration dependencies.
* Own major or recurring issue progression, bringing together internal resolver groups, engineering teams and vendors as required.
* Ensure incident records include clear technical findings, actions, evidence, workarounds, resolution details and follow-up requirements.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for repeat failures, alert noise and avoidable ticket demand.

**Service Reliability and Monitoring**

* Use operational data and monitoring insights to identify device-health risks, recurring alert patterns, estate-wide issues and service degradation.
* Partner with monitoring and engineering teams to improve alert quality, routing, thresholds and actionable diagnostics.
* Track device compliance, connectivity, application and operating-system health, and operational readiness across in-scope platforms.
* Coordinate recovery campaigns and validate that restored devices remain stable after corrective action.

**Device Lifecycle Operations**

* Oversee operational support for meeting-room device onboarding, configuration validation, readiness testing, BAU handover, replacement and offboarding.
* Confirm that prerequisite activities, dependencies, ownership and acceptance criteria are understood before L3 work begins.
* Coordinate with project managers, onsite support and dependent platform teams to resolve gaps affecting deployment or decommissioning.
* Maintain accurate operational records, handover evidence and supporting documentation for lifecycle activities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Escalation Management**

* Provide concise updates on service impact, current status, risks, decisions, dependencies and expected next actions.
* Facilitate technical bridges and cross-team troubleshooting for high-impact or multi-domain issues.
* Engage OEMs and support partners for advanced diagnostics, defect investigation, warranty and replacement cases.
* Ensure escalations are evidence-based, assigned to the appropriate owner and progressed until closure or formal handoff.

**Governance, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, support boundaries and escalation paths.
* Review service performance, ticket ageing, recurring failure themes, backlog, restoration trends and improvement opportunities.
* Drive automation, monitoring enhancements, self-heal opportunities and ticket-elimination initiatives with measurable outcomes.
* Support operational readiness for new products, platform changes, service transitions and global deployment programmes.
* Promote compliance with change, incident, problem, asset, security and data-handling requirements.

  

**Technology and Service Environment**

**Area Indicative Environment**

**Meeting-room platforms :** Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android, Surface Hub, interactive displays, video-conferencing endpoints, room bars, cameras, microphones, speakers, touch panels and room-signage devices

**Operations tooling :** ServiceNow, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, monitoring platforms such as Utelogy, Microsoft Intune, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories

**Technical domains :** Windows and Android endpoints, Teams Rooms applications, device accounts, identity and access, networking fundamentals, firmware, drivers, peripherals, remote management and AV signal flow

**Service practices**: Incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, vendor, warranty/RMA, onboarding, offboarding and operational reporting

  

**Candidate Profile**

**Required Experience and Knowledge**

* Demonstrable experience leading or coordinating advanced AV, unified communications, meeting-room or endpoint operations in an enterprise environment.
* Strong troubleshooting experience across Microsoft Teams Rooms, room peripherals, endpoint operating systems, device management and network dependencies.
* Experience managing complex incidents, technical escalations, vendors and cross-functional resolver teams.
* Practical understanding of IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, request and knowledge management.
* Experience producing operational reports, trend analysis, executive updates, technical documentation and knowledge content.
* Ability to work effectively in a global support model and coordinate across regions, time zones and diverse stakeholder groups.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in information technology, electronics, telecommunications, AV systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, vendor or service-management certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, Power BI, Power Query or comparable monitoring and analytics platforms.
* Exposure to device lifecycle programmes, service transition, automation and large-scale operational recovery initiatives.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Operations Manager Intern
description:
**Company:** Fawrit Technologies India Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Kalamassery, Kochi, Kerala  
**Role Type:** Internship | Hybrid (Primarily On-site)  
**Duration:** 6 Months  
**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM  
**Monthly Stipend:** ₹5,000 – ₹10,000, based on performance during the interview  
**Full-Time Opportunity:** ₹20,000 – ₹40,000 per month, based on performance and business requirements  
**Joining:** Immediate

About the Role

Fawrit Technologies is looking for an **Operations Manager Intern** to support and coordinate day-to-day operations across our laundry partners, riders, customers, and internal technical team.

The role involves managing operational communication through WhatsApp and other communication channels, monitoring orders, coordinating pickups and deliveries, following up with laundry partners and riders, assisting customers, and ensuring operational issues are followed up and resolved efficiently.

This is a people-facing operations role that requires strong communication, responsiveness, ownership, problem-solving ability, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and follow-ups simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities1. Order & Operations Coordination

* Monitor incoming orders and ensure they move smoothly through the service process.
* Track orders from customer pickup through laundry processing to final delivery.
* Follow up on pending, delayed, or problematic orders.
* Coordinate with partners and riders to ensure timely order completion.
* Keep order information and status updates accurate in the system.
* Identify operational issues and take timely action or escalate them when required.

2. Estimates, Invoices & Payments

* Assist with preparing and sharing estimates with customers when required.
* Share invoices and payment links after confirming the necessary order details.
* Follow up on pending payments when required.
* Ensure payment and order-related information is accurately recorded.

3. Partner Coordination

* Communicate with laundry partners regarding orders, service progress, and operational requirements.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with existing partners.
* Understand partner concerns, requirements, and operational challenges.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams to address partner issues.
* Communicate customer requirements and special instructions to partners.
* Assist with the coordination and onboarding of new partners when required.

4. Customer & Rider Coordination

* Communicate with customers regarding pickups, deliveries, order updates, and service-related queries.
* Coordinate with riders regarding pickup and delivery schedules.
* Communicate customer requests, changes, and important order information to riders.
* Follow up with riders to ensure pickups and deliveries are completed on time.
* Assist in resolving routine customer and rider concerns.
* Ensure customers receive timely updates regarding order status and delays.

5. Internal & Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with the internal technical team regarding operational or system-related issues.
* Clearly communicate reported issues, requirements, and customer or partner concerns.
* Follow up with the relevant team until the issue is addressed.
* Keep the manager updated on important operational issues.
* Escalate customer complaints, partner concerns, payment issues, rider problems, or unusual situations when necessary.

6. Communication & Follow-Up

* Manage multiple WhatsApp conversations and operational requests efficiently.
* Respond to customers and partners in a timely and professional manner.
* Maintain proper follow-up on unresolved issues.
* Ensure important conversations, customer requests, and operational requirements are not missed.
* Maintain accurate records of relevant operational activities.
* Provide regular updates on pending orders, operational challenges, and unresolved issues.

What We're Looking For

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills.
* Good organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple conversations and tasks simultaneously.
* Basic computer and application-handling skills.
* Good attention to detail.
* Problem-solving ability and willingness to take ownership.
* Ability to remain calm and professional while handling operational issues.
* Ability to communicate professionally with customers, riders, and business partners.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Willingness to communicate through WhatsApp and other business communication channels.
* Ability to follow up on tasks independently and ensure issues are addressed.
* Willingness to work primarily from the office in Kalamassery, Kochi.

Internship Details

* **Duration:** 6 months.
* **Work Mode:** Hybrid, with work primarily conducted on-site at the Kochi office.
* **Working Hours:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM.
* **Monthly Stipend:** ₹5,000 – ₹10,000, determined based on the candidate's skills and performance during the interview.
* **Joining:** Immediate.

Full-Time Opportunity

Based on individual performance and business requirements, successful interns may be considered for a full-time opportunity upon completion of the internship, with a potential monthly compensation package of **₹20,000 – ₹40,000**.

Full-time conversion is not guaranteed and will depend on the intern's performance, demonstrated ownership, ability to handle the role independently, and the company's business requirements at that time.

Role Objective

The **Operations Manager Intern** will serve as a central coordination point between customers, riders, laundry partners, and the internal team.

The primary objective is to ensure that day-to-day operations run smoothly, communication is handled effectively, operational issues are followed up, and orders move efficiently from pickup to final delivery.

The intern is expected to demonstrate accountability, maintain clear communication, and proactively follow up on operational tasks to support a reliable customer experience.

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month

description:
Job Summary

Caspian Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a proactive and technically competent **Facility Manager** to oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of our commercial mall property at Willingdon Island, Kochi.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on, boots-on-the-ground leader with strong technical knowledge of **MEP systems, particularly STP (Sewage Treatment Plant), mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems**. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the property remains safe, functional, well-maintained, and professionally managed while delivering high standards of facility operations, statutory compliance, and customer service.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Facility Operations & Maintenance**

* Oversee daily operations, maintenance, and upkeep of the mall property and common areas.
* Ensure the smooth functioning of all building infrastructure, utilities, and essential services.
* Conduct regular site inspections to identify maintenance issues, safety risks, and areas requiring improvement.
* Implement preventive and corrective maintenance schedules to minimize equipment breakdowns and operational disruptions.

**2. MEP & Technical Systems Management**

* Monitor and maintain STP operations, including treatment processes, water quality, equipment performance, and statutory compliance.
* Oversee electrical systems, DG sets, transformers, panels, lighting, and power distribution.
* Supervise mechanical systems, pumps, motors, ventilation, HVAC, and other building equipment.
* Ensure proper functioning of plumbing, drainage, water supply, and water management systems.
* Coordinate with technical teams and external vendors for troubleshooting, repairs, and major maintenance activities.
* Maintain equipment logs, service records, maintenance schedules, and technical documentation.

**3. Vendor & Service Team Management**

* Supervise housekeeping, security, technical maintenance, landscaping, and other outsourced service teams.
* Monitor vendor performance, manpower deployment, service quality, and adherence to agreed SLAs.
* Coordinate with contractors and service providers for routine maintenance, repairs, and facility improvement works.
* Ensure effective coordination between internal teams, tenants, vendors, and management.

**4. Safety, Statutory Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety, fire safety, environmental, building, and other statutory requirements.
* Monitor fire-fighting systems, fire alarms, emergency exits, and other life-safety equipment.
* Conduct routine safety inspections and coordinate emergency response drills.
* Ensure proper maintenance of statutory records, inspection reports, licences, and compliance documentation.
* Identify potential operational risks and implement appropriate corrective and preventive measures.

**5. Budgeting & Administrative Control**

* Prepare and monitor facility maintenance budgets, utility expenses, and vendor costs.
* Track electricity, water, diesel, and other utility consumption and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Maintain records of maintenance expenses, purchase requirements, service contracts, and asset inventories.
* Submit regular operational reports, breakdown reports, and maintenance updates to management.

**6. Housekeeping & Property Presentation**

* Maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and presentation across common areas and service zones.
* Ensure proper waste management and adherence to environmental and hygiene standards.
* Monitor the overall condition of the property and ensure timely resolution of maintenance complaints.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil Engineering, or Facilities Management.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in facility management, preferably in malls, commercial buildings, hotels, or large-scale properties.
* Strong practical knowledge of **STP operations, MEP systems, electrical infrastructure, plumbing, pumps, motors, and building maintenance**.
* Experience in managing housekeeping, security, technical maintenance, and outsourced service providers.
* Knowledge of preventive maintenance, safety procedures, statutory compliance, and emergency management.
* Strong vendor coordination, team management, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, email communication, maintenance documentation, and reporting.
* Ability to work independently, conduct regular site inspections, and handle operational issues proactively.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* A hands-on professional who can actively supervise site operations rather than rely solely on administrative reporting.
* Experience in managing commercial properties with multiple service teams and critical utility systems.
* Strong focus on safety, asset upkeep, service quality, and cost control.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills to coordinate effectively with management, vendors, tenants, and on-site personnel.
* Candidates with immediate or short-notice availability will be preferred.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst - NVIDIA Alliance - Supervising Associate
description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 14, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1747958

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title:** GDS Alliance Operations Lead Analyst

**Job Span:** NVIDIA Alliance

**Function**: GDS ES Growth & Innovation

**Skill Level:** High

**Sub Function:** Alliances Program Operations CoE

  

**Job Summary:**

The GDS Alliance Operations Lead Analyst will operate from the GDS Alliances Program Operations CoE and provide structured operations, governance, stakeholder coordination, reporting, content management and execution support for the NVIDIA Alliance within the broader Global Alliances and Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The role will help alliance leadership run an effective, insight-led and scalable operating model by tracking priorities, managing operational cadence, improving process discipline and enabling timely execution of NVIDIA alliance initiatives across sell, build and deliver motions. The incumbent will work closely with alliance, market, finance, contracts, training, BMC and enablement stakeholders to strengthen delivery consistency, improve data and reporting quality, simplify ways of working and identify automation opportunities, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, enhance reporting narratives and improve operational outcomes.

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Serve as the central operations and PMO support point for assigned alliance activities, ensuring priorities, workstreams, owners, timelines, risks, dependencies and follow-ups are clearly captured, tracked and progressed with discipline.
    
  Provide NVIDIA alliance leadership with timely business insights through structured reporting, dashboards and executive-ready narratives covering sales, pipeline, opportunity tagging, partner-sourced and co-sell activity, prospect tracking, key GTM wins, book of business movements, partner program measures and other performance indicators.
    
  Support governance cadence for leadership meetings, QBRs, planning forums and operational reviews by developing agendas, storyboarding content, coordinating inputs, preparing meeting materials, capturing actions and tracking closure.
    
  Maintain and continuously refresh alliance reference materials, SharePoint content, leadership-ready presentations, internal updates and other enablement assets to improve findability, consistency, relevance and adoption across stakeholder groups.
    
  Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams to develop, review and maintain alliance-related content, ensuring alignment with messaging standards, stakeholder expectations and partner program requirements.
    
  Program manage NVIDIA partner tools, portals and operational processes, including partner portal access request tracking, issue resolution, adoption monitoring, certification and skills currency tracking, training coordination and tool administration support.
    
  Work with alliance investment, finance, legal and enablement teams to support NVIDIA Market Development Fund processes, investment tracking, compliance monitoring, quarterly reviews, documentation readiness, claims support and process adherence.
    
  Support NVIDIA alliance contract and governance activities, including initiation and tracking of localization of global agreements, program documentation, partner distinction or specialization requirements and related compliance actions in collaboration with the Ecosystem Contracts team and relevant business stakeholders.
    
  Partner with onshore NVIDIA alliance enablement contacts on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, stakeholder mapping, partner offering or marketplace coordination, event or sponsorship coordination, training interventions and other priority initiatives as required.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve alliance operations processes through process mapping, documentation, issue analysis, control strengthening, data quality improvement and adoption of reusable templates and playbooks.
    
  Leverage automation and responsible AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to reduce repetitive manual activity, improve reporting turnaround time, support content drafting, enhance insight generation, improve follow-up tracking and enable scalable service delivery.
    
  Manage stakeholder expectations, communication plans and delivery commitments with clarity, responsiveness and strong service orientation across global and regional teams.
* Knowledge and Skill Requirements:
* Strong understanding of alliance, ecosystem or partner program operations, preferably in a professional services, technology, consulting, shared services, GCC or global capability center environment; exposure to NVIDIA, accelerated computing, AI platforms, enterprise technology or digital transformation ecosystems would be advantageous.
* Working knowledge of sales, revenue, pipeline, opportunity lifecycle, partner program metrics, GTM motions, co-sell or referral activity, partner distinctions, specialization requirements and performance reporting, with the ability to interpret data and convert it into concise executive-ready insights.
* Strong program and project management skills, including planning, tracking, governance cadence management, risk and dependency monitoring, action follow-up and management of multiple priorities with competing deadlines.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, workflow tools or other reporting and collaboration platforms considered an advantage.
* Experience with continuous improvement, process simplification and operational excellence, including process mapping, SOP development, control documentation, audit readiness, root cause analysis and issue resolution.
* Ability to identify automation opportunities and apply digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, reporting quality, follow-up discipline, knowledge management and stakeholder experience.
* Practical exposure to generative AI tools for research, content development, summarization, insight generation, workflow support and productivity enhancement; preferable exposure to Agentic AI concepts,
* AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
* Strong stakeholder management capability, with the ability to engage senior onshore stakeholders, anticipate needs, manage expectations and build trusted advisor relationships across functions and geographies.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including business writing, executive presentation development, narrative building and the ability to create high-quality content with limited initial guidance.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, research capability and attention to detail, with the ability to work across multiple teams to drive practical and timely resolution.
* Experience working in virtual, matrixed and multi-geography environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline and a global mindset.
* Knowledge of EY and GDS operations, organization structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts for internal candidates; Big 4, consulting, technology or leadership support exposure for external candidates would be preferred.

  

**Job Requirements:**

**Academics:**

* MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; degree in business, technology, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline preferred.
* Project/program management certification, process improvement certification, or relevant alliance, partner program, NVIDIA, technology partner or enterprise software certification would be an added advantage.
* Relevant certifications or digital badges in generative AI, responsible AI, AI-enabled productivity, prompt engineering, automation, analytics, or Agentic AI concepts would be highly desirable, particularly where they demonstrate practical application in business operations, reporting, process improvement, knowledge management, or stakeholder enablement.

  

**Experience:**

* 8+ years of progressive, relevant experience in alliance operations, program management, business operations, sales/GTM enablement, ecosystem support, consulting operations, technology partner enablement or enterprise technology partner operations; exposure to NVIDIA or comparable technology alliance environments would be preferred.
* Demonstrated experience supporting senior stakeholders in a matrixed, global environment, with exposure to governance routines, executive reporting, process coordination, and cross-functional delivery.
* Experience in reporting, dashboarding, content development, stakeholder tracking, or operational improvement initiatives would be beneficial.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
